name: smwmusic-sonic-3-knuckles-fleet-of-the-gods-flying-battery-zone-act
title: Sonic 3 & Knuckles - Fleet of the Gods ~ Flying Battery Zone Act 1 (Hakurei-Mix)
description:
Did a special arrangement of the fifth eighth zone from Sonic 3 & Knuckles, Flying Battery Zone Act 1 for my 1.5K subscriber milestone. One of my favorite songs of all-time!! It's just got the perfect intensity while also having incredibly memorable melodies to support this masterpiece of a song, and it's just... SO FREAKING GOOD!!

I made sure to go all out on this one!!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. B Minor (AoCF Pitch)

And... there are also two versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables the voice clip (Listening-Only)
2. Disables the voice clip (SMW-Compatible, turned on default)
